subject: @CopyToClipboard browser acceptance

decisiveCopy.method: one real CDP click on the card control, system clipboard read from outside the browser
decisiveCopy.whyThisMatters: jsdom can only prove a mock was called; this reads the OS clipboard, which is what any other application would paste

contrast.note: the control uses the outline variant; primary is 4.23:1 in light, a recorded accepted defect of the existing Button palette that a new control must not inherit

notes: readText() cannot be awaited from a script without a user activation: it never settles and the CDP call hits the 20s harness bound. The clipboard is read from the OS instead, which is stronger evidence.
sync then observe then act invalidates the context the action needs: the order is observe, sync, act.
a session fixes its control policy at creation, so --policy strict cannot be added later.
